_comment: Example fleet configuration for the Reach bridge (see README.md, 'Fleet mode'). JSON has no comments, so this note rides in a field the bridge ignores. This file is the fleet's record: the device_id values below are the fleet's real console device IDs, with assignments approved by Mike on 2026-11-13. Copy this file to fleet-config.json in a private location and run the bridge against the copy — never commit your private copy or any local changes to it. All five phones live on the one console account (console_account); each working phone manages its holding's mailbox (mailbox). API keys are NOT stored here and never appear in this repo: give each phone its own scoped key (platform/create-key.py) and pass it to the bridge as PHONEUSE_API_KEY. api_base is the verified local PhoneUse API; it does not change per phone. The reserve phone is disabled by default ('enabled': false) — do not point the bridge at it until it is activated and an assignment is approved. The bridge refuses to run a holding whose device_id is still the placeholder REPLACE_WITH_CONSOLE_DEVICE_ID.
